integrity.finite_checks: exact integer enumeration, n≤15, and coefficient regression through n=80
integrity.infinite_proof: explicit finite-state transition matrices and algebraic spectral analysis

scientific_limitations: Only projective reductions modulo the primes 3 and 5 are classified; not general primes or prime powers.
Sharp limiting amplitudes are evaluated for residue zero and infinity; the other class bounds follow from spectral roots but their amplitudes are not individually tabulated.
Finite computational checks do not constitute an infinite proof.
An earlier equivalent projective random walk treatment cannot be excluded without further literature review.
title: Sharp square-root residue oscillations in the ternary and quinary Calkin–Wilf levels
